display.purpose: Hand-lettered chalk headings and the brand.

shadows.name: card-pasteboard
shadows.purpose: Physical card faces sitting on the slate.

components.name: Chalk Button
components.description: Chalk-stroke button; primary variant is amber-armed.
components.css: .chalk-btn { font-family: 'Patrick Hand', cursive; font-size: 1.25rem; color: #f2f5ef; background: transparent; border: 2px solid #e4e9e0; border-radius: 6px; padding: 0.5rem 1.5rem; cursor: pointer; } .chalk-btn--primary { border: 3px solid #d9a94e; color: #e8c882; } .chalk-btn:active { background: #f2f5ef; color: #141c17; }

components.name: Drawn Panel
components.description: Double-line chalk frame with corner ticks; never a filled card.
components.css: .panel { position: relative; background: #18221b; border: 2px solid #cfd6ca; border-radius: 6px; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.35), inset 0 0 0 4px #18221b, inset 0 0 0 5px rgba(242,245,239,0.28); }

narrative.overview: The interface is the scorer's pad every home game actually keeps: a green-black slate behind the counter, chalk line work, real pasteboard cards dealt on top as the only full-color objects. Nothing is a casino and nothing is a dashboard; the numbers are chalked, not streamed. Panels are drawn, not filled.
keyCharacteristics: Slate ground, chalk line work, single warm accent
Drawn panels with corner ticks, never filled cards
Real card faces as the only full-color objects

rules.name: The Pasteboard Monopoly Rule
rules.body: Full color belongs to card faces alone; UI chrome is chalk on slate.

rules.name: The Hand-Only Rule
rules.body: No system fonts; a glyph rendering in a platform font is a bug.

dos: Use chalk grammar for state: solid committed / dashed pending / ghost last round
Draw icons as inline SVG in chalk stroke
Theme browser surfaces from the palette
donts: No casino iconography: felt, gold trim, suite decorations, dice
